status: Original tunable game-physics design assumptions. JSON contains numbers and metadata, not imported geometry. This is not a verified KAOPU editor save format.

assumptions.inherited_candidates: Three equal cylinders; 0.457 m bore; 0.711 m stroke; 1.90 m drivers. Mass 205 t, effective inertia factor 1.08, 60 t adhesive load and mu=0.15 are design study assumptions, not measured values.
assumptions.pressure: Usable thermal reserve E=C*(p-p_exhaust), hot-start only; not IAPWS, vessel design, boiler-water-level or cold-start simulation.
assumptions.valves: Cycle-averaged double-acting p-V work with polytropic expansion and exhaust floor. Throttle is an ideal effective admission-pressure control plus finite valve flow capacity, not exact regulator geometry or valve timing.
assumptions.adhesion: Ideal instantaneous pressure/steam reduction to mu*Madh*g; no wheelspin, slip loss or real historical anti-slip hardware.
assumptions.water: Finite usable feedwater inventory; no boiler/tender split or feed pump dynamics.
assumptions.resistance: Uncalibrated A+B|v|+Cv^2 resistance and grade mg*sin(atan(grade)); no curvature, coupler slack, derailment or route profile.
assumptions.brake: Aggregate train brake with first-order build/release and adhesion bound; not air/vacuum pipe simulation or stopping-distance certification.
